ayahs.2: Hum ne yeh Quran tujh par is liye nahin utaara ke tu mashaqqat mein pad jaaye.
ayahs.3: Balke is ki naseehat ke liye jo Allah se darta hai.
ayahs.4: Is ka utaarna us ki taraf se hai jis ne zameen ko aur buland aasmanon ko paida kiya hai.
ayahs.5: Jo Rahman hai, arsh par qaaim hai.
ayahs.6: Jis ki milkiyat aasmanon aur zameen aur in donon ke darmiyan aur (kura-e-khaak) ke neeche ki har ek cheez par hai.
ayahs.7: Agar tu oonchi baat kahe to woh to har ek posheeda, balke posheeda se posheeda-tar cheez ko bhi ba-khoobi jaanta hai.
ayahs.8: Wahi Allah hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, behtareen naam usi ke hain.
ayahs.9: Tujhe Moosa (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bhi maloom hai?
ayahs.10: Jab ke us ne aag dekh kar apne ghar walon se kaha ke tum zara si der thehar jao, mujhe aag dikhaai di hai. Bahut mumkin hai ke main is ka koi angaara tumhare paas laun ya aag ke paas se raaste ki ittila paun.
ayahs.11: Jab woh wahan pahunche to aawaaz di gayi, aye Moosa!
ayahs.12: Yaqeenan main hi tera parwardigar hoon, tu apni jootiyan utaar de, kyunke tu paak maidan Tuwa mein hai.
ayahs.13: Aur main ne tujhe muntakhab kar liya, ab jo wahi ki jaaye use kaan laga kar sun.
ayahs.14: Beshak main hi Allah hoon, mere siwa ibaadat ke laayeq aur koi nahin, pas tu meri hi ibaadat kar, aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qaaim rakh.
ayahs.15: Qayamat yaqeenan aane wali hai jise main posheeda rakhna chahta hoon taake har shakhs ko woh badla diya jaaye jo us ne koshish ki ho.
ayahs.16: Pas ab is ke yaqeen se tujhe koi aisa shakhs rok na de jo is par imaan na rakhta ho aur apni khwahish ke peechhe pada ho, warna tu halaak hojaayega.
ayahs.17: Aye Moosa! Tere is daaen haath mein kya hai?
ayahs.18: Jawab diya ke yeh meri laathi hai, jis par main teik lagaata hoon aur jis se main apni bakriyon ke liye patte jhaad liya karta hoon aur bhi is mein mujhe bahut se faaide hain.
ayahs.19: Farmaya, aye Moosa! Use haath se neeche daal de.
ayahs.20: Daalte hi woh saanp ban kar daudne lagi.
ayahs.21: Farmaya be-khauf ho kar use pakad le, hum use usi pehli si surat mein dobara la denge.
ayahs.22: Aur apna haath apni baghal mein daal le to woh safed chamakta hua ho kar niklega, lekin baghair kisi aib (aur rog) ke, yeh doosra mojiza hai.
ayahs.23: Yeh is liye ke hum tujhe apni badi badi nishaaniyan dikhana chahte hain.
ayahs.24: Ab tu Firaun ki taraf ja, is ne badi sarkashi macha rakhi hai.
ayahs.25: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha aye mere parwardigar! Mera seena mere liye khol de.
ayahs.26: Aur mere kaam ko mujh par aasaan kar de.
ayahs.27: Aur meri zabaan ki girah bhi khol de.
ayahs.28: Taake log meri baat achhi tarah samajh saken.
ayahs.29: Aur mera wazeer mere kunbe mein se kar de.
ayahs.30: Yani mere bhai Haaroon (alaihis salaam) ko.
ayahs.31: Tu is se meri kamar kas de.
ayahs.32: Aur use mera shareek-kaar kar de.
ayahs.33: Taake hum donon ba-kasrat teri tasbeeh bayan karen.
ayahs.35: Beshak tu hamein khoob dekhne bhaalne wala hai.
ayahs.36: Janab-e-Baari Taala ne farmaya, Moosa tere tamaam sawaalat poore kar diye gaye.
ayahs.37: Hum ne to tujh par ek baar aur bhi bada ehsan kiya hai.
ayahs.38: Jab ke hum ne teri maan ko woh ilhaam kiya jis ka zikr ab kiya ja raha hai.
ayahs.39: Ke tu use sandooq mein band karke darya mein chhod de, pas darya use kinare la daalega aur mera aur khud is ka dushman use le lega, aur main ne apni taraf ki khaas mohabbat-o-maqbooliyat tujh par daal di, taake teri parwarish meri aankhon ke saamne ki jaaye.
ayahs.40: (Yaad kar) jab ke teri behen chal rahi thi aur keh rahi thi ke agar tum kaho to main use bata doon jo is ki nigehbaani kare, is tadbeer se hum ne tujhe phir teri maan ke paas pahunchaya ke is ki aankhen thandi rahen aur woh ghamgeen na ho. Aur tu ne ek shakhs ko maar daala tha, is par bhi hum ne tujhe gham se bacha liya, gharz hum ne tujhe achhi tarah aazma liya. Phir tu kayi saal tak Madyan ke logon mein thehra raha, phir taqdeer-e-Ilahi ke mutaabiq, aye Moosa! Tu aaya.
ayahs.41: Aur main ne tujhe khaas apni zaat ke liye pasand farma liya.
ayahs.42: Ab tu apne bhai samet meri nishaaniyan hamraah liye hue ja, aur khabardaar mere zikr mein susti na karna.
ayahs.43: Tum donon Firaun ke paas jao, is ne badi sarkashi ki hai.
ayahs.44: Use narmi se samjhao ke shaayad woh samajh le ya dar jaaye.
ayahs.45: Donon ne kaha aye hamare Rabb! Hamein khauf hai ke kahin Firaun hum par koi ziyaadti na kare ya apni sarkashi mein badh na jaaye.
ayahs.46: Jawab mila ke tum mutlaqan khauf na karo, main tumhare saath hoon aur sunta dekhta rahoonga.
ayahs.47: Tum is ke paas ja kar kaho ke hum tere parwardigar ke paighambar hain to hamare saath Bani Israeel ko bhej de, un ki sazaayen mauqoof kar. Hum to tere paas tere Rabb ki taraf se nishani le kar aaye hain aur salaamati usi ke liye hai jo hidayat ka paaband hojaaye.
ayahs.48: Hamari taraf wahi ki gayi hai ke jo jhutlaaye aur rogardaani kare is ke liye azaab hai.
ayahs.49: Firaun ne poochha ke aye Moosa tum donon ka Rabb kaun hai?
ayahs.50: Jawab diya ke hamara Rabb woh hai jis ne har ek ko is ki khaas surat, shakl enaayat farmaayi phir raah sujha di.
ayahs.51: Us ne kaha achha, yeh to batao agle zamane walon ka haal kya hona hai.
ayahs.52: Jawab diya ke un ka ilm mere Rabb ke haan kitaab mein maujood hai, na to mera Rabb ghalti karta hai na bhoolta hai.
ayahs.53: Usi ne tumhare liye zameen ko farsh banaya hai aur is mein tumhare chalne ke liye raaste banaaye hain aur aasman se paani bhi wahi barsaata hai, phir is barsaat ki wajah se mukhtalif qisam ki paidaawaar bhi hum hi paida karte hain.
ayahs.54: Tum khud khao aur apne chaupaayon ko bhi charao. Kuchh shak nahin ke is mein aqalmandon ke liye bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.55: Isi zameen mein se hum ne tumhein paida kiya aur isi mein phir wapas lautaayenge aur isi se phir dobara tum sab ko nikaal khada karenge.
ayahs.56: Hum ne use apni sab nishaaniyan dikha din, lekin phir bhi is ne jhutlaaya aur inkaar kar diya.
ayahs.57: Kehne laga aye Moosa! Kya tu isi liye aaya hai ke hamein apne jaadu ke zor se hamare mulk se bahar nikaal de.
ayahs.58: Achha hum bhi tere muqaable mein isi jaisa jaadu zaroor laayenge, pas tu hamare aur apne darmiyan ek wade ka waqt muqarrar kar le, ke na hum is ka khilaaf karen aur na tu, saaf maidan mein muqaabla ho.
ayahs.59: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne jawab diya ke zeenat aur jashn ke din ka wada hai aur yeh ke log din chadhe hi jama hojaayen.
ayahs.60: Pas Firaun laut gaya aur us ne apne hathkande jama kiye phir aagaya.
ayahs.61: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha tumhari shaamat aa chuki, Allah Taala par jhoot aur iftira na baandho ke woh tumhein azaabon se maliyamet kar de, yaad rakho woh kabhi kaamyaab na hoga jis ne jhooti baat ghadi.
ayahs.62: Pas yeh log aapas ke mashwaron mein mukhtalif raaye hogaye aur chhup kar chupke chupke mashwara karne lage.
ayahs.63: Kehne lage yeh donon mahaz jaadugar hain aur un ka pukhta irada hai ke apne jaadu ke zor se tumhein tumhare mulk se nikaal bahar karden aur tumhare behtareen mazhab ko barbaad karden.
ayahs.64: To tum bhi apna koi daanw utha na rakho, phir saf-bandi karke ao. Jo ghaalib aagaya wahi baazi le gaya.
ayahs.65: Kehne lage ke aye Moosa! Ya to tu pehle daal ya hum pehle daalne wale ban jaayen.
ayahs.66: Jawab diya ke nahin, tum hi pehle daalo. Ab to Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko yeh khayaal guzarne laga ke un ki rassiyan aur lakadiyan un ke jaadu ke zor se daud bhaag rahi hain.
ayahs.67: Pas Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne dil hi dil mein dar mahsoos kiya.
ayahs.68: Hum ne farmaya kuchh khauf na kar, yaqeenan tu hi ghaalib aur bartar rahega.
ayahs.69: Aur tere daaen haath mein jo hai use daal de ke un ki tamaam kaarigari ko woh nigal jaaye, unhon ne jo kuchh banaya hai yeh sirf jaadugaron ke kartab hain aur jaadugar kahin se bhi aaye kaamyaab nahin hota.
ayahs.70: Ab to tamaam jaadugar sajde mein gir pade aur pukar uthe ke hum to Haaroon aur Moosa (alaihimas-salaam) ke Rabb par imaan laaye.
ayahs.71: Firaun kehne laga ke kya meri ijaazat se pehle hi tum is par imaan le aaye? Yaqeenan yehi tumhara woh bada buzurg hai jis ne tum sab ko jaadu sikhaya hai, (sun lo) main tumhare paon ulte seedhe katwa kar tum sab ko khajoor ke tanon mein sooli par latakwa doonga, aur tumhein poori tarah maloom hojaayega ke hum mein se kis ki maar ziyaada sakht aur dair-pa hai.
ayahs.72: Unhon ne jawab diya ke na-mumkin hai ke hum tujhe tarjeeh den un daleelon par jo hamare saamne aa chuken aur us Allah par jis ne hamein paida kiya hai, ab to tu jo kuchh karne wala hai kar guzar, tu jo kuchh bhi hukm chala sakta hai woh isi dunyawi zindagi mein hi hai.
ayahs.73: Hum (is umeed se) apne parwardigar par imaan laaye ke woh hamari khataayen maaf farma de aur (khaas kar) jaadugari (ka gunaah), jis par tum ne hamein majboor kiya hai, Allah hi behtar aur hamesha baaqi rehne wala hai.
ayahs.74: Baat yehi hai ke jo bhi gunahgaar ban kar Allah Taala ke haan haazir hoga is ke liye dozakh hai, jahan na maut hogi aur na zindagi.
ayahs.75: Aur jo bhi is ke paas imaan ki haalat mein haazir hoga aur is ne aamaal bhi nek kiye honge is ke liye buland-o-baala darje hain.
ayahs.76: Hameshgi wali jannaten jin ke neeche nahren lahren le rahi hain jahan woh hamesha (hamesha) rahenge. Yehi inaam hai har us shakhs ka jo paak hua.
ayahs.77: Hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki taraf wahi naazil farmaayi ke tu raaton raat mere bandon ko le chal, aur un ke liye darya mein khushk raasta bana le, phir na tujhe kisi ke aa pakadne ka khatra hoga na dar.
ayahs.78: Firaun ne apne lashkaron samet un ka taaqub kiya, phir to darya un sab par chha gaya jaisa kuchh chha jaane wala tha.
ayahs.79: Firaun ne apni qaum ko gumraahi mein daal diya aur seedha raasta na dikhaaya.
ayahs.80: Aye Bani Israeel! Dekho hum ne tumhein tumhare dushman se najaat di aur tum se koh-e-Toor ki daaen taraf ka wada kiya aur tum par mann-o-salwa utaara.
ayahs.81: Tum hamari di hui paakeeza rozi khao, aur is mein hadd se aage na badho, warna tum par mera ghazab naazil hoga, aur jis par mera ghazab naazil hojaaye woh yaqeenan tabaah hua.
ayahs.82: Haan beshak main unhein bakhsh dene wala hoon jo tauba karen, imaan laayen, nek amal karen aur raah-e-raast par bhi rahen.
ayahs.83: Aye Moosa! Tujhe apni qaum se (ghaafil karke) kaun si cheez jaldi le aayi?
ayahs.84: Kaha ke woh log bhi mere peechhe hi peechhe hain, aur main ne, aye Rabb! Teri taraf jaldi is liye ki ke tu khush hojaaye.
ayahs.85: Farmaya! Hum ne teri qaum ko tere peechhe aazmaaish mein daal diya aur unhein Saamri ne bahka diya hai.
ayahs.86: Pas Moosa (alaihis salaam) sakht ghazabnaak ho kar ranj ke saath wapas laute, aur kehne lage ke aye meri qaum walo! Kya tum se tumhare parwardigar ne nek wada nahin kiya tha? Kya is ki muddat tumhein lambi maloom hui? Balke tumhara irada hi yeh hai ke tum par tumhare parwardigar ka ghazab naazil ho? Ke tum ne mere wade ka khilaaf kiya.
ayahs.87: Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum ne apne ikhtiyaar se aap ke saath wade ka khilaaf nahin kiya. Balke hum par zewaraat-e-qaum ke jo bojh laad diye gaye the unhein hum ne daal diya, aur isi tarah Saamri ne bhi daal diye.
ayahs.88: Phir us ne logon ke liye ek bachhda nikaal khada kiya, yani bachhde ka but, jis ki gaay ki si aawaaz bhi thi, phir kehne lage ke yehi tumhara mabood hai aur Moosa ka bhi, lekin Moosa bhool gaya hai.
ayahs.89: Kya yeh gumraah log yeh bhi nahin dekhte ke woh to un ki baat ka jawab bhi nahin de sakta aur na un ke kisi bure bhale ka ikhtiyaar rakhta hai.
ayahs.90: Aur Haaroon (alaihis salaam) ne is se pehle hi un se keh diya tha, aye meri qaum walo! Is bachhde se to sirf tumhari aazmaaish ki gayi hai, tumhara haqeeqi parwardigar to Allah Rahman hi hai, pas tum sab meri tabedaari karo. Aur meri baat maante chale jao.
ayahs.91: Unhon ne jawab diya ke Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki wapsi tak to hum isi ke mujaawir bane baithe rahenge.
ayahs.92: Moosa (alaihis salaam) kehne lage aye Haaroon! Unhein gumraah hota hua dekhte hue tujhe kis cheez ne roka tha.
ayahs.93: Ke tu mere peechhe na aaya. Kya tu bhi mere farmaan ka naafarmaan ban baitha.
ayahs.94: Haaroon (alaihis salaam) ne kaha aye mere maan-jaaye bhai! Meri daadhi na pakad aur sar ke baal na kheench, mujhe to sirf yeh khayaal daaman-geer hua ke kahin aap yeh (na) farmaayen ke tu ne Bani Israeel mein tafarqa daal diya aur meri baat ka intezaar na kiya.
ayahs.95: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne poochha, Saamri tera kya maamla hai.
ayahs.96: Us ne jawab diya ke mujhe woh cheez dikhaai di jo unhein dikhaai nahin di, to main ne firistaada-e-Ilahi ke naqsh-e-qadam se ek mutthi bhar li, use is mein daal diya, isi tarah mere dil ne yeh baat mere liye bhali bana di.
ayahs.97: Kaha achha ja, dunya ki zindagi mein teri saza yehi hai ke tu kehta rahe ke mujhe na chhoona, aur ek aur bhi wada tere saath hai jo tujh se hargiz na talega, aur ab tu apne is mabood ko bhi dekh lena jis ka aitikaaf kiye hue tha ke hum use jala kar darya mein reza reza uda denge.
ayahs.98: Asal baat yehi hai ke tum sab ka mabood-e-bar-haq sirf Allah hi hai is ke siwa koi parastish ke qaabil nahin. Is ka ilm tamaam cheezon par haawi hai.
ayahs.99: Isi tarah hum tere saamne pehle ki guzri hui waardaaten bayan farma rahe hain aur yaqeenan hum tujhe apne paas se naseehat ata farma chuke hain.
ayahs.100: Is se jo munh pher lega woh yaqeenan qayamat ke din apna bhaari bojh laade hue hoga.
ayahs.101: Jis mein hamesha hi rahega, aur un ke liye qayamat ke din (bada) bura bojh hai.
ayahs.102: Jis din soor phoonka jaayega aur gunahgaaron ko hum is din (dahshat ki wajah se) neeli peeli aankhon ke saath gher laayenge.
ayahs.103: Woh aapas mein chupke chupke keh rahe honge ke hum to (dunya mein) sirf das din hi rahe.
ayahs.104: Jo kuchh woh keh rahe hain is ki haqeeqat se hum ba-khabar hain, un mein sab se ziyaada achhi raah wala keh raha hoga ke tum to sirf ek hi din rahe.
ayahs.105: Woh aap se pahaadon ki nisbat sawaal karte hain, to aap keh den ke unhein mera Rabb reza reza kar ke uda dega.
ayahs.106: Aur zameen ko bilkul hamwaar saaf maidan kar ke chhodega.
ayahs.107: Jis mein tu na kahin mod dekhega na oonch neech.
ayahs.108: Jis din log pukaarne wale ke peechhe chalenge jis mein koi kaji na hogi aur Allah Rahman ke saamne tamaam aawazen past hojaayengi siwaaye khusar-phusar ke, tujhe kuchh bhi sunaai na dega.
ayahs.109: Is din sifaarish kuchh kaam nahin aayegi magar jise Rahman hukm de aur is ki baat ko pasand farmaaye.
ayahs.110: Jo kuchh un ke aage peechhe hai use Allah hi jaanta hai, makhlooq ka ilm is par haawi nahin ho sakta.
ayahs.111: Tamaam chehre us zinda aur qaaim-daaim mudabbir, Allah ke saamne kamaal aajizi se jhuke hue honge, yaqeenan woh barbaad hua jis ne zulm laad liya.
ayahs.112: Aur jo nek aamaal kare aur imaan wala bhi ho to na use be-insaafi ka khatka hoga na haq-talfi ka.
ayahs.113: Isi tarah hum ne tujh par Arabi Quran naazil farmaya hai aur tarah tarah se is mein dar ka bayan sunaaya hai taake log parhezgaar ban jaayen ya un ke dil mein soch-samajh to paida kare.
ayahs.114: Pas Allah aali-shaan wala sachcha aur haqeeqi baadshah hai. To Quran padhne mein jaldi na kar is se pehle ke teri taraf jo wahi ki jaati hai woh poori ki jaaye, haan yeh dua kar ke parwardigar! Mera ilm badha.
ayahs.115: Hum ne Aadam ko pehle hi taakeedi hukm diya tha lekin woh bhool gaya aur hum ne is mein koi azm nahin paaya.
ayahs.116: Aur jab hum ne farishton se kaha ke Aadam (alaihis salaam) ko sajda karo to Iblees ke siwa sab ne kiya, us ne saaf inkaar kar diya.
ayahs.117: To hum ne kaha aye Aadam! Yeh tera aur teri biwi ka dushman hai (khayaal rakhna) aisa na ho ke woh tum donon ko jannat se nikalwa de ke tu museebat mein pad jaaye.
ayahs.118: Yahan to tujhe yeh aaraam hai ke na to bhooka hota hai na nanga.
ayahs.119: Aur na tu yahan pyaasa hota hai na dhoop se takleef uthaata hai.
ayahs.120: Lekin shaitan ne use waswasa daala, kehne laga ke main tujhe daaimi zindagi ka darakht aur baadshaahat batlaun ke jo kabhi puraani na ho.
ayahs.121: Chunaanche in donon ne is darakht se kuchh kha liya, pas un ke satr khul gaye aur bahisht ke patte apne oopar taankne lage. Aadam (alaihis salaam) ne apne Rabb ki nafarmaani ki, pas bahak gaya.
ayahs.122: Phir is ke Rabb ne nawaaza, is ki tauba qubool ki aur is ki rahnumaai ki.
ayahs.123: Farmaya, tum donon yahan se utar jao, tum aapas mein ek doosre ke dushman ho, ab tumhare paas kabhi meri taraf se hidayat pahunche to jo meri hidayat ki pairwi kare na to woh bahkega na takleef mein padega.
ayahs.124: Aur (haan) jo meri yaad se rogardaani karega is ki zindagi tangi mein rahegi, aur hum use baroz-e-qayamat andha kar ke uthaayenge.
ayahs.125: Woh kahega ke Ilahi! Mujhe tu ne andha bana kar kyun uthaaya? Halaanke main to dekhta bhaalta tha.
ayahs.126: (Jawab milega ke) isi tarah hona chahiye tha, tu meri aayi hui aayaton ko bhool gaya, tu aaj tu bhi bhula diya jaata hai.
ayahs.127: Hum aisa hi badla har us shakhs ko diya karte hain jo hadd se guzar jaaye aur apne Rabb ki aayaton par imaan na laaye, aur beshak aakhirat ka azaab nihaayat hi sakht aur baaqi rehne wala hai.
ayahs.128: Kya un ki rahbari is baat ne bhi nahin ki ke hum ne un se pehle bahut si bastiyan halaak kardi hain jin ke rehne sehne ki jagah yeh chal phir rahe hain. Yaqeenan is mein aqalmandon ke liye bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.129: Agar tere Rabb ki baat pehle hi se muqarrar-shuda aur waqt-e-mueen-karda na hota to isi waqt azaab aa chimatta.
ayahs.130: Pas un ki baaton par sabr kar aur apne parwardigar ki tasbeeh aur tareef bayan karta reh, sooraj nikalne se pehle aur is ke doobne se pehle, raat ke mukhtalif waqton mein bhi aur din ke hisson mein bhi tasbeeh karta reh, bahut mumkin hai ke tu raazi hojaaye.
ayahs.131: Aur apni nigahen hargiz un cheezon ki taraf na daudaana jo hum ne in mein se mukhtalif logon ko araaish-e-dunya ki de rakhi hain, taake unhein is mein aazma len, tere Rabb ka diya hua hi (bahut) behtar aur baaqi rehne wala hai.
ayahs.132: Apne gharaane ke logon par namaz ki taakeed rakh aur khud bhi is par jama reh, hum tujh se rozi nahin maangte, balke hum khud tujhe rozi dete hain, aakhir mein bol baala parhezgaari hi ka hai.
ayahs.133: Unhon ne kaha ke yeh Nabi hamare paas apne parwardigar ki taraf se koi nishani kyun nahin laaya? Kya un ke paas agli kitaabon ki waazeh daleel nahin pahunchi?
ayahs.134: Aur agar hum is se pehle hi unhein azaab se halaak karde to yaqeenan yeh keh uthte ke aye hamare parwardigar tu ne hamare paas apna Rasool kyun na bheja? Ke hum teri aayaton ki tabedaari karte is se pehle ke hum zaleel-o-ruswa hote.
ayahs.135: Keh dijiye! Har ek anjaam ka muntazir hai pas tum bhi intezaar mein raho. Anqareeb qatan jaan loge ke raah-e-raast wale kaun hain aur kaun raah-yaafta hain.
